text.card: A red giant 3,539 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.13 solar masses and 10.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,707 K at its surface.
